messages:
maria_cs: FYI we found a short billing-ledger regression affecting trial->seat conversions for 3 tenants starting ~11:05 UTC. Seat confirmations stalled and webhooks retried. Preparing proactive comms + credits.

alex_se: Investigating. Looks like a retry/backoff bug causing an error loop when the ledger returned 502 under load. Pushing a targeted hotfix to throttle retries. ETA ~10m.

luis_support: Two tenants already opened tickets (TenantX, TenantY). TenantZ in live support. I'll mark TenantX as priority due to renewal timing.

sarah_ops: We need a billing script to apply credits for the impact window. Can you output a CSV of impacted tenant IDs once you confirm?

emily_rev: For the renewal-risk account let's offer an elevated credit (10%) + 1:1 AM call. I'll coordinate with Maria.

deploy-bot: Hotfix canary deployed at 3801234620 — 1/2 instances. No error spike seen.

alex_se: Rolling full rollout now. Will post final impacted list after verification.

maria_cs: Draft customer message: "Hi <Name>, we experienced a transient billing-ledger sync error between 11:05 and 11:28 UTC that may have delayed seat assignments. We deployed a fix and retried pending tasks. We're applying a 5% invoice credit and offering 2 hours of onboarding help; renewal-risk customers will receive a tailored offer. Reply if you still see issues. Feedback: https://redwood.io/incident-feedback"

luis_support: Updating tickets and sending the message to affected tenants as soon as you send final copy.

sarah_ops: Ready to run credit script when you share impacted IDs and time window.

alex_se: Full rollout completed at 3801234688. No regressions in the last 2m. Impacted list csv attached in thread.

maria_cs: Sent the outbound notes to the three tenants at 3801234695 and scheduled office hours. Action items: Alex share csv + script, Sarah execute credits, Luis close tickets after verification, Emily follow up with renewal account. I'll run a PSAT in 24h. :thumbsup:
